definitions.explanation: An increase in wages or salary, typically negotiated between employers and employees or their unions.

examples.japanese: {賃上|ちんあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}する→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{春闘|しゅんとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{賃上|ちんあ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Significant wage increases were achieved in this year's spring labor negotiations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見合|みあ}った→見合う：14391_miau⟧{賃上|ちんあ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われなければ→行う：01238_okonau⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦|くる}しく→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧だ。
examples.english: If wage increases that match rising prices are not implemented, life will only become harder.

notes:
{賃上|ちんあ}げ is a compound of ⟦{賃|ちん}→〜賃：28343_chin⟧ (wages) and {上|あ}げ (raising). The opposite is {賃下|ちんさ}げ (wage cut).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賃上|ちんあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}する→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧ (demand a pay raise)
- {賃上|ちんあ}げ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧ (wage negotiations)
- {賃上|ちんあ}げ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate of wage increase)
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{賃上|ちんあ}げ (substantial wage increase)

This word appears frequently in news about labor relations, especially during the annual {春闘|しゅんとう} (spring labor offensive), when Japanese unions negotiate wages with employers.
